name: Achensee Schifffahrt
kurzbeschreibung: Since 1887, Achenseeschifffahrt has connected the largest lake in Tyrol: round trips and scheduled services at six landing stages with Alpine panorama.
beschreibung: Achenseeschifffahrt – Since its founding in 1887, Achenseeschifffahrt-GmbH has connected the largest lake in Tyrol with a passion for boating and hospitality. In 1887, the steamship 'St. Josef' began operations as the first vessel. Today the fleet consists of the modern scheduled ships MS Achensee, MS Stadt Innsbruck and MS Tirol. The ships operate around the Achensee and call at six landing stages, including Pertisau, Seespitz, Buchau, Scholastika, the Seehofkapelle and the Gaisalm, which can be reached only on foot or by boat. The north and south round trips depart exclusively from Pertisau. On board, panoramic windows, an on-board restaurant as well as cakes, snacks and drinks provide enjoyable moments with views of the Karwendel and Rofan. The head office with office is located at Seepromenade 36 in 6213 Pertisau.
